title: T3 — Statement of Architecture Work
body:
# Statement of Architecture Work — T3 PM job

## Assignment

The T3 slice (issue #74) under the programme's PM governance; the live delivery contract is
`01a2052f-29da-76c4-9bda-e45e0f408fe8`, requested by the PM job and approved by the Architecture Board under the standing
delegation.

## Scope

The PM request-to-plan path (`pm.plan`, `projects.baseline`), the dual-controlled charter,
baseline and change gates, the change-request path with its impact block, and closure against the
frozen baseline (`projects.close_request`, `projects.close`). Not in scope: project creation and
the board surfaces, which belong to S05.

## Responsibilities

The PM job requests and plans; the approver job decides every gate and is never its requester;
the programme manager owns delivery; the architect owns the baseline's architecture content; the
programme board reviews the tranche.

## Acceptance criteria

SPEC_V2 §12 T3: "PM runs a request end to end; cannot approve its own gate; a baseline change
requires a change request". The manifest `acceptance/programme/T3.toml` is the gate, not this
document; its checks execute against the live rows.

## Contract

The live `delivery_contract` `01a2052f-29da-76c4-9bda-e45e0f408fe8` (phase g), approved by the Board decision under the standing
delegation; its body names the same scope, obligations and acceptance.
